thread:
arjun: hey folks :wave: I accepted the org invite but when I try to push to a repo I get a 403. Also the 'Request to join team' button for eng-runtime isn't showing for me. who should I ping for perms?
julia: which repo are you trying to push to? can you paste the exact error? sometimes this is an SSO or 2FA issue.
arjun: here's the error I see when I try to push:
```
remote: You don't have permission to push to this repository.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
I already enabled 2FA and clicked the invite link but still no team join button.
kevin: thanks — quick check on my side shows your account is in the org but SSO status is still "pending". If you accepted the invite from a different browser or mobile, the SSO authorize sometimes doesn't attach to your active desktop session. Can you go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click "Authorize" from the same browser where you're signed in?
arjun: ah, good call. I clicked authorize on mobile earlier, trying from desktop now... I'm getting a small modal error that says "SSO authorization failed" when I click authorize.
kevin: okay I'm going to re-send the org invite and add you to eng-runtime + docs teams. one sec. cc @invite-bot
invite-bot: Re-sent org invite to arjun@example.com at 2025-11-12T14:18:05Z
kevin: done — you should see a new invite. after you accept and authorize SSO, try: `gh auth login` then `git push`. if you're still blocked, check whether your git remote is using https with a cached credential from another account. you can also test SSH: `ssh -T git@github.com` and ensure your pubkey is in GitHub settings.
arjun: i just accepted the new invite and authorized SSO from desktop — it worked. i can also see the eng-runtime team now. tried the push and it's successful. thanks for the quick help :tada:
julia: welcome to the team! if you need access to model-eval or infra repos, ping me or kevin and we'll add you. also add your SSH pubkey under Settings -> SSH and GPG keys so pushes are smoother.
arjun: will do, thanks everyone :wave:
